text.en:
Section eleven of Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and twenty is amended so as to
read as follows:
"Section 11. There is appropriated, out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the
sum of five hundred and fifty thousand pesos, for the purpose of organizing the corporation and conducting
the preliminary work: Provided, That the said amount shall be reimbursed to the Philippine Treasury upon the
certification of the Auditor General that the corporation is in a financial condition to do so, and by virtue of
such certification, the National Power Board shall approve a resolution authorizing the treasurer of the
corporation to make the necessary payment.
"As soon as the construction of any project is decided upon, the corporation may issue bonds for financing the
project in accordance wit: the provisions of section four of this Act."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 24, 1938.
